verdict.rationale: Token2 ships an open-source CLI (fido2-manage) that overlaps with much of the companion GUI's functionality — resident credential/passkey management, PIN setup, biometric template management, and SSH key operations can all be scripted — giving some AI-native/automation parity with the desktop UI. However, there is no true REST/HTTP API (probes confirm openapi.json/swagger.json all 404), and several UI-only web tools (TOTP toolset, WebAuthn browser demo, factory reset) have no documented programmatic equivalent. Missing for 10: a formal API surface (REST/OpenAPI) covering all UI functions, CLI/API parity for the web-based demo and TOTP tools, and independent confirmation that CLI coverage is fully equivalent to the GUI.
